metadata.title: How Wholesalers Can Turn Title Problems Into Profitable Curative Deals
metadata.author: Courtney Fricke
metadata.shortDescription:
Real estate wholesalers are trained to find motivated sellers, negotiate the right price, and get deals closed. But what happens when a title or ownership problem gets in the way?

In this episode of the Messy Money Podcast, Courtney Fricke sits down with Stephen Keighery of Home Buyer Louisiana to discuss how an established wholesaling operation approaches curative title issues without trying to turn its acquisitions team into title experts.

Stephen explains why wholesalers don't necessarily need a dedicated curative title division—they need enough competency to recognize potentially solvable problems, determine whether the economics justify pursuing them, and know who to call when the problem exceeds their expertise. 


ATTENTION:

The information shared in this episode is for educational and informational purposes only and reflects personal experiences and opinions. It is not intended as legal, tax, financial, or investment advice. Real Estate laws, tax rules, and regulations vary by state and situation. Always consult with a qualified attorney, CPA, or other licensed professional before making any Real Estate or financial decisions.
